name: Kymco Super 8 / Super 9
engine: 49 cc two-stroke or 49 to 150 cc four-stroke, CVT
intro: Kymco's sporty small scooters. The Super 9 is a two-stroke; most Super 8s are four-strokes.

B: Some years are two-strokes and some are four-strokes. Check yours before you buy oil, plugs or carb parts.

recallNote: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start. Recalls on these models change over time.
